reason: The two failures came from the hard, undiscovered server work consuming the whole budget; what remains is small, pattern-following, and precisely scripted by the handoff, so four standalone-green slices each fit one iteration: (1) the single diagnosed drone hover fix to make the server suite 4/4 green and committed, (2) the 2D client slice (hazard store, exposure HUD, dev route, __HAZARD__ hook), (3) the 3D slice (WorldManager hazard discs + drone meshes, pad-pattern culling), (4) the storm-cell e2e with screenshot plus the parent-task close-out. Committed work (shared hazards module + 19 unit tests, full server sim, 3/4 shard tests) is left as done; together the four tasks cover every remaining acceptance criterion, each builds only on the ones before it, and each ends with a green suite and a commit.
